ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity (white) across the lateral lobes and 30% low-intensity (black/dark grey) concentrated in the central notch and medial trailing edge regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centrally located low-intensity triangular mass extending from the notch towards the mid-lobes. Transition zones exhibit high-contrast pixel mottling. One distinct circular dark focal spot is isolated in the upper-medial region of the left white lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 105 degrees and high pixel-depth relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing boundary. Irregular pixel-amplitude peaks are more pronounced on the left medial edge compared to the relatively smoother right distal edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory observed along the trailing edges of both lobes, curving upwards towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two high-contrast circular marks: one dark ring on the white field of the left lobe, and one white-centered ring within the dark pigment of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (scratches) concentrated on the lower-medial quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular tissue indentation on the right interior wall of the central notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Cluster of dark, high-contrast speckling at the extreme terminus of the left fluke tip.
